# See https://www.robotstxt.org/robotstxt.html for documentation

# --- Sitemap ---
Sitemap: https://rootly.com/sitemap.xml

# --- AI crawlers are explicitly welcome (goal #19) ---
# Never blocked or challenged. Listed explicitly as a safeguard even though
# the general rule below already allows them.
User-agent: GPTBot
Allow: /

User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Allow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-Web
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Allow: /

User-agent: Applebot-Extended
Allow: /

# --- General rules ---
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Block sensitive or private app pages
Disallow: /account
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /teams
# ...except customers' public status pages, /teams/<team>/status-pages/<page>/public
# and what sits under it (history, incident pages), which live has always let
# every crawler index. The longer Allow wins; the rest of the status-page tree
# (subscription dialogs, settings) stays blocked.
Allow: /teams/*/status-pages/*/public

# Block internal search parameters (prevents duplicate content).
# Legacy Webflow pagination (?b9e754a1_page=2) is deliberately NOT blocked: the
# Worker 301s it to the clean URL, and a crawler can only follow that redirect
# if it is allowed to fetch the old URL.
# This unblocks every `*_page=` query, not only the eight-hex Webflow family the
# Worker redirects, and that is intended: robots.txt wildcards cannot express
# "eight hex characters", so any rule that still blocked `?per_page=` would also
# block `?b9e754a1_page=`. The wider surface is harmless. The rebuilt site emits
# no `_page` parameter of its own, and any other variant serves the page with a
# canonical to the clean URL (Base.astro derives it from the path alone).
Disallow: /*?search=
Disallow: /*?q=

# Block system / non-content pages. Each error route is served under its own
# status code at the edge, but also builds as a reachable 200 page.
Disallow: /400
Disallow: /403
Disallow: /404
Disallow: /406
Disallow: /422
Disallow: /500
Disallow: /503
Disallow: /search
Disallow: /search/

# Legacy taxonomy routes (retained from the prior site; harmless if unused)
Disallow: /tag/
Disallow: /category/

# Block non-HTML document downloads that aren't useful to index.
# Comments kept on their own lines so all parsers read the directives cleanly.
Disallow: /*.doc
Disallow: /*.docx
Disallow: /*.xls
Disallow: /*.xlsx
Disallow: /*.ppt
Disallow: /*.pptx
Disallow: /*.zip
Disallow: /*.rar
Disallow: /*.csv

# PDFs: block by default, but allow gated resources under /resources/
Disallow: /*.pdf
Allow: /resources/*.pdf

# Note: unlike the prior site, SVG and JSON are NOT disallowed — brand logos
# ship as SVG and should stay crawlable/renderable, and blocking /*.json can
# hurt rendering of pages that fetch JSON. (Prior robots blocked both.)

# --- Crawl-delay (only if the origin needs it) ---
# Crawl-delay: 2

# --- End of robots.txt ---
